checks.label: Lines that simply cross do not join unless the crossing is marked: the lamp's line crosses the motor's cable with no dot, so the line leaving -Q1 reaches the starter and the lamp but not the motor, and a dot there joins them

A circuit diagram does not show how long its connections are: dragged to the far side, the starter keeps every line, each stretched square between the same two ends, and the line leaving -Q1 still reaches the same parts
A schematic gives how the system works, not where its parts sit: moving the motor and pump across the room moves its pipe in the room, and leaves the diagram drawn exactly the same

Each symbol is drawn in its normal or neutral condition: valve -V2 is drawn shut, where its spring holds it, and opens only with its solenoid on; contacts are drawn with the coil off, so the main contact is drawn open and a normally closed one closed

Counted by hand: the line leaving -Q1 reaches 2 parts (3 counting the motor through the crossing, 1 down one branch); the starter's output line in the new layout reaches 3 (4 counting -H1, 2 missing a branch, 1 the motor alone); the typed fields ask exactly these
Drawings A and C join every part the same way, so they are one diagram drawn twice, though C moves every part; B is laid out like A but feeds its lamp from the starter's output
The heaters drawn in a row: every path from the supply passes through -E1 first, then splits through -E2 or -E3 and joins again, and the usual shape keeps every joint
On the air sheet the air reaches -R1 first, then -V2, then -A1, though -A1 sits at the top left of the sheet
The link joins the supply's line to the starter's line round -Q1: with -Q1 open the drawing still joins the supply to -K1, and without the link it would not
Before an answer nothing gives it away: no puzzle has a line lit or a motion played, both typed screens' readouts show ?, and the contact's state now is not shown
Every demonstration settles within 4.5 s of its screen opening, and every answer's motion within 2.5 s
